title: ECHA Opens Public Consultation on Universal PFAS Restriction Proposal
summary: The European Chemicals Agency has opened a public consultation on a broad restriction covering the manufacture, use, and placing on the market of PFAS as a class, with limited use-specific derogations under review.

title: ECHA Proposes Restriction Amendment Targeting PFHxS and Related Substances
summary: A proposed amendment would extend existing PFOS-style restrictions to PFHxS and its salts, citing persistence and bioaccumulation data submitted by member state authorities.

title: EU Drinking Water Directive: Tighter PFAS Limits Take Effect Across Member States
summary: Revised total-PFAS and "sum of 20" thresholds under the recast Drinking Water Directive are now binding for water suppliers, with compliance deadlines staggered through 2028 for smaller utilities.

title: US EPA Finalizes Enforcement Guidance for PFAS Drinking Water MCLs
summary: EPA published enforcement discretion guidance for public water systems working toward compliance with maximum contaminant levels for PFOA and PFOS, including monitoring and treatment technology benchmarks.

title: Umweltbundesamt Publishes Updated PFAS Soil Screening Values for Industrial Sites
summary: Germany's federal environment agency revised precautionary soil and groundwater screening values for several PFAS compounds at contaminated industrial and landfill sites, tightening thresholds for short-chain substances.

title: Peer-Reviewed Study: Electrochemical Oxidation Shows Promise for Cost-Effective PFAS Destruction at Scale
summary: A pilot-scale study of boron-doped diamond electrode systems reports high degradation efficiency for short- and long-chain PFAS in landfill leachate, with energy demand identified as the primary scale-up cost driver.

title: German Landfill Operator Named in Class Action Over PFAS Leachate Contamination
summary: A regional landfill operator faces a civil suit alleging insufficient leachate treatment led to PFAS contamination of nearby groundwater, adding to a growing wave of European PFAS liability litigation.

title: Major Chemicals Manufacturer Expands PFAS Remediation Fund for European Sites
summary: Following settlements in North America, a global chemicals manufacturer announced additional remediation funding earmarked for European manufacturing and disposal sites with documented PFAS releases.
